description: Curated Root-of-Trust (RoT) and Rust/C Firmware CWE Taxonomy stratified by NCM Domain Subtlety level

1.name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
1.rot_manifestation: Wrapping payload length or header offset arithmetic (e.g., wrapping_add / unchecked cast) bypassing buffer length validation.

1.name: Out-of-bounds Read
1.rot_manifestation: Unchecked slice indexing or pointer arithmetic reading past command mailbox or certificate parsing buffers.

1.name: Out-of-bounds Write
1.rot_manifestation: Off-by-one or miscalculated length bound when copying mailbox command words or cryptographic digest outputs.

1.name: Always-Incorrect Control Flow Implementation
1.rot_manifestation: Inverted boolean status check or early return on error path allowing unauthorized command execution.

2.name: Sensitive Information in Resource Not Removed Before Reuse
2.rot_manifestation: Omitting zeroization of Key Vault Staging buffers, CDI/DPE intermediate seeds, or mailbox SRAM after command completion or error.

2.name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
2.rot_manifestation: Accepting partial digest match, skipping ECDSA/LMS signature verification flag check on warm reset, or ignoring public key revocation mask.

2.name: Improper Certificate Validation
2.rot_manifestation: Failing to enforce X.509/DICE certificate key-usage bits, basic constraints, or TCB SVN monotonic version comparison.

2.name: Incomplete Internal State Distinction
2.rot_manifestation: Failing to transition or lock DPE context / boot lifecycle state between ROM -> FMC -> Runtime handover.

3.name: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
3.rot_manifestation: TOCTOU window where SoC DMA / mailbox register words are re-read from shared SRAM/MMIO after header validation.

3.name: Improper Finite State Machines (FSMs) in Hardware Logic / Firmware Handshake
3.rot_manifestation: Missing hardware status-ready poll or clearing crypto engine lock bit before hardware operation finishes.

3.name: Incorrect Default Permissions (MPU / PMP / KeyVault Lock)
3.rot_manifestation: Misconfiguring PMP/MPU region permissions or failing to set KeyVault slot write-lock bit prior to untrusted runtime jump.

3.name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
3.rot_manifestation: Non-constant-time byte-by-byte tag or HMAC comparison leaking cryptographic secret material across the mailbox interface.
